agents.go.no_live_run: Folder {folder} has no active run. Start one: op=begin&folder={folder}
agents.go.round_line: Round {n} — {what} {no} “{title}” sent it back: {result}. “Input” has fresh answers and the previous input.
agents.go.scheme_dir_agent: ./{path} — in your current folder (the server gives the full path at begin)
agents.go.agent_dir_make: The work folder is on your side: {dir}. Create it now: mkdir -p '{dir}/in' '{dir}/out/r{no}'
agents.go.out_dir: Materials — in/. Put results in {rel} unless the task names another place — wherever the task or “Input” says out/…, it means {rel}
agents.go.about: Description (overrides the spec; if they differ, follow the description):
agents.go.block_files_web: Block materials (read before work; with a link — first download into your folder: curl -s -o <path> '<link>'; without a link — it is already in your scheme folder):
agents.go.paid_max: Paid calls at most: {n} — add how many you used to the answer: calls=<number>
agents.go.paid_spent: Paid calls in this run so far: {n} (from block answers)
agents.go.stuck_no_spec: no task (description and spec are empty)
agents.go.scheme_live: run r{no} is going — what to do: op=where&run=r{no}
agents.go.run_going: the folder already has run r{no} going
agents.go.not_ready: SCHEME NOT READY — the run was not started:
agents.go.first_not_issued: the first step was not issued:
agents.go.warn_form: answer does not match the pattern “{answer}”
agents.go.warn_paid: paid calls {calls} with a limit of {paid}
agents.go.warn_math: arithmetic does not match the input: submitted {got}
agents.go.map_note1: Only to understand the run, not a plan: the server drives the run,
agents.go.map_note2: your job is the “NEXT” line. ▣ block · ◆ decision · ◯ starter
agents.go.one_run: This folder already has a run going
agents.go.one_entry: The scheme has {n} entries — the simple path runs schemes with one entry
agents.go.wrong_block: the answer is for task {no}.{try}, but done is for block {block}. Not accepted: check whose answer it is
agents.go.no_block: Block {no} is not in this scheme
agents.go.need_branch: Block {no} is a decision: a branch is needed, &branch=yes or &branch=no
agents.go.gateway_done:
ok: gateway {no} → folder {target} “{name}” · task {no}.{try}
   the target folder run does not start by itself; continue only on the human's word: op=begin&folder={target}
agents.go.repeat_task: repeat: task {task} was already accepted with this answer — nothing changes
agents.go.other_round: The answer to task {task} was not accepted: {open}. It answers another round — wait for the answer to the open task or see op=where
agents.go.repeat_block: repeat: block {no} was already accepted with this answer — nothing changes
agents.go.not_open_where: Block {no} is not open now — see op=where
agents.go.next_submit: you do it yourself — submit: op=done
agents.go.next_wait: waiting for the worker answer · op=wait
agents.go.diamond: DECISION — Jev did not decide, decide yourself
agents.go.idle: nothing to do yet{wait} — wait: op=wait&run=r{no}
agents.go.none_open: no block is open now — see op=where
agents.go.many_open: several blocks are open: {list} — say which: &block=N
agents.go.no_block_lc: block {no} is not in this scheme
agents.go.scheme_file: Scheme overview (for context, not a task):
agents.go.not_issued: block {no} is not issued now — there is no task, see op=where
agents.go.no_text: No such text: “{task}”. The address comes from the “task at link” line (block.round), or scheme or worker.
agents.go.scheme_file_head: Overview of the scheme “{name}” — only to understand the run,
agents.go.scheme_file_note: this is not a task. There are no specs here: do only what the task says.
agents.go.scheme_file_legend: ▣ block — worker job · ◆ decision — the server picks the branch · ◯ starter — run start
agents.go.ev_self: the lead took it on itself
agents.go.solo_no_invite: The leader does everything: no worker invite is needed
agents.go.bad_reply: reply is the leader address: letters, digits, “_”, “.” and “-”, e.g. term_3da280c1-…
agents.go.how_orca_reply: Answer me with one command: orca terminal send --terminal {reply} --text 'WORKER ANSWER: <line by the pattern>' --enter --wait-submit 4 --json — no line breaks. After sending, end your turn and wait for the next task at the input line, not with sleep.
agents.go.how_orca: Answer me with orca terminal send, one line by the pattern from the task — no line breaks. After sending, end your turn and wait for the next task at the input line, not with sleep.
agents.go.how_send: Answer me via SendMessage{to}, one line by the pattern from the task.
agents.go.how_sub: You are my subagent: your answer is the last line of your final message, by the pattern from the task. Do not send anything to anyone.
agents.go.then_task: Now read the instructions and do the task — it is below in this same message.
agents.go.then_wait: Now read the instructions and wait for a task.
agents.go.invite: You are the worker of run r{no} “{name}” in Goblin. Read the instructions at the link in full — curl -s '{file}' — and work strictly by them. Tasks come as the line “task at link ADDRESS” — read the task in full: curl -s 'ADDRESS'; paths in the task are relative to the work folder. {how} Call the Goblin server only for these links. {then}
agents.go.already_closed: run r{no} is already closed ({state}) — nothing changes
agents.go.reset_issue: the issue of block {no} was removed
agents.go.reset_back: ok: {what}{with}. Next: op=again on what comes before it — or op=where to issue everything again
agents.go.redo: ok: block {no} will be done again{with}
agents.catalog.digest_head:
# Catalog experience

Catalog sections and the ready schemes in them. The scheme key is in brackets: pick the base by it.
